name: AKLM-FINAL-v3
purpose: Benchmark for freshness-aware adaptive RAG, selective re-indexing, stale knowledge detection, conflict detection and retrieval gating.
evaluation_input: evaluation/* (do not index these labels into the RAG)
version_timestamps_note: Synthetic release schedule: V01=2026-01-01, each subsequent version +7 days. change_event_timestamp = release date of to_version.
gold_answer_spec: questions.csv gold_answer is deterministically derived from the canonical corpus (template-parsed entities) and lifecycle/changes.csv. supporting_chunk_ids point to rag/chunks.csv rows; citation_required_document_ids point to corpus document ids. retrieval_control questions carry no chunks/citations and gold = arithmetic answer.
notes: Finalized without changing the 20,000-record P01-P10 corpus structure.
Removed 300 lifecycle page_addition/page_deletion records because those inventory events were not represented by corpus snapshots.
Repaired 15 conflict cases that compared a version to itself by pairing each with the next version.
All 15 repaired conflict pairs have observable page-level content differences.

v3.1 derived-label extension: all new artifacts (page_hashes, chunk_changes, version_timestamps, index_snapshots, stale_replacements) are derived from the canonical corpus/chunks; no corpus record was added, edited, or removed.

stale_cases extended 1200 -> 2000 to the full website x version-pair cross-product, including previously missing V01->V02, V08->V10 and V09->V10 pairs; every stale question now links 1:1 to a stale_case row (fresh index cases V01->V01 intentionally have no case).
conflict_cases extended 150 -> 200 so every website has a conflict record; resolution metadata added (resolved_version = max(version_a, version_b), snapshot_is_newer, resolution_rule).
questions.csv extended with deterministic gold_answer, supporting_chunk_ids, citation_required_document_ids and gold_available=yes for all 5,200 rows.

requires_reembedding='conditional' (2,000 reordering rows) is retained as the original lifecycle signal; embedding_affected is computed deterministically from chunk-text equality (no embedding model dependency).
100% consecutive-version content change rate is retained.
